desc: This Orlivane necklace combines the Celtic trinity knot with a heart-shaped stone in your birthstone color. The copper pendant is plated in a silver tone with darkened knot lines and holds a ring of blue-green glass around the heart. It measures 26.2 x 20 mm and hangs from a stainless steel chain, 45 cm long with a 5 cm extender. Each necklace comes in a white gift box. Available in 12 month colors. Care: keep away from water, perfume and chemicals, and store dry.
b: TRINITY KNOT AND HEART — A Celtic trinity knot pendant with a heart-shaped birthstone-color stone in the center and a ring of blue-green glass inside the knot.
12 BIRTHSTONE COLORS — Choose the color for each month, January to December. The heart stone is AAA cubic zirconia in birthstone colors, not a natural gemstone.
SIZE AND WEIGHT — The pendant measures 26.2 x 20 mm (1.03 x 0.79 in) with a 5 mm heart stone. The necklace weighs about 8.5 g.
ADJUSTABLE CHAIN — Stainless steel chain, 45 cm (17.7 in) plus a 5 cm (2 in) extender.
READY TO GIFT — Comes in a white gift box, ready for a birthday, anniversary or Mother's Day gift for a wife, mother, daughter or friend.
